description: PENgram relationship type vocabulary. Source of truth is pengram/vocabulary.py — this JSON mirrors it for non-Python consumers.

types.updates: This adds to or refines existing knowledge.
types.evolution_of: This shows how thinking changed over time.

evidence.description: How claims relate to each other as evidence.

types.supports: This provides evidence for another claim.
types.disputes: This questions the reasoning of another.

types.parent_of: This is a broader topic containing the other.
types.child_of: This is a subtopic of the other.
types.sibling_of: These are peers under the same parent topic.
types.composed_of: This is made up of the other.
types.part_of: This is a component of the other.

types.causes: This leads to or produces the other.
types.influenced_by: This was shaped by the other.
types.prerequisite_for: This must come before the other.

implementation.description: Realization, documentation, testing, and instance relationships.

types.implements: This is a concrete realization of the other.
types.documents: This describes or records the other.
types.tests: This validates or verifies the other.
types.example_of: This is an instance of a general pattern.

types.responds_to: This is a reply or reaction to the other.
types.references: This cites or points to the other.
types.inspired_by: This was sparked by the other.

types.follows: This comes after the other in a process.
types.precedes: This comes before the other in a process.

types.depends_on: This requires the other to function.

structural_types.description: Deterministic code/AST relationships produced by tree-sitter extraction.

types.uses: Symbol uses another symbol (variable, type reference).
types.implements_interface: Class implements an interface or protocol.
types.instantiates: Code instantiates a class or type.
types.decorates: Decorator wraps a function or class.

confidence_labels.EXTRACTED: Relationship stated explicitly in the source content.
confidence_labels.INFERRED: Relationship deduced from context but not explicitly stated.

defaults.description: Fallback relationship type per entity kind when the LLM cannot confidently assign a type.
